executability-1: PLAN.md §Work items W-1 — the 구체적 변경 column says '어떤 행을 마크할지, user_confirm 행을 누가 마크할지는 구현하면서 정한다', so W-1 cannot be implemented without more design; the implementer has to fill in the mapping and the owner
